result.topic_en: Observations of the Pole Star (Polaris) at upper culmination on 19 May 1818 at the two wires of a transit instrument, with times, microscope readings averaged over three microscopes, reductions, and a derived distance between the wires, followed by logarithmic computations.

methods.what: Averaging readings of all three microscopes for each observation
Adding reductions (Red) to microscope readings and taking the mean of reduced values for each wire
Distance between the two wires obtained as the difference of the mean reduced readings at the two wires (1'24"10 - 1'2"94)
Logarithmic computation (difference of logarithms) used in the reduction
